correctness.rationale: The first t-1 draws are distinct, must include repeated label i and any t-2 others; their (t-1)! permutations give the exact joint law for every 2<=t<=m+1. Excluding pair i,j gives ratio (pi/pj)^2 (E_k+pj E_(k-1))/(E_k+pi E_(k-1)). Newton log-concavity yields strictly increasing E_(k-1)/E_k, including zero and infinity endpoints; hence odds strictly increase for pi<pj. Summing conditional pair differences yields the threshold-event ordering and declining E[p_R|T] except uniform vectors. Independent exhaustive rational first-repeat enumeration for m=4, p=(1,2,3,4)/10 matched every time-conditioned law, and checked endpoints. Includes edge m=2 and equal-probability equality.

value.rationale: The repeated category given first collision time is a natural statistic for nonuniform birthday sampling. Its exact all-time rare-label shift, not merely marginal collision probability, offers a sharp pairwise stochastic-order classification over every alphabet size. A future probabilistic inference analysis can use this specific posterior ordering.

limitations: Finite strictly positive iid categorical weights; no null outcomes, dependent sampling, higher collision multiplicities or infinite alphabets.
Finite enumeration is supporting evidence only.
